description: Training Knowledge patterns describing reusable expert reasoning boundaries derived from verified Golden cases G001 and G003.

patterns.name: Normative Reference Applicability
patterns.principle: An explicit normative reference used by the project as the basis for a design decision is itself an auditable project fact and may require an independent normative-reference check.
required_evidence: explicit project reference to a normative document
normative document/version used as the project basis
patterns.reasoning_boundary: Do not replace a normative-reference check with an engineering-parameter check merely because the same project fragment also contains a numeric engineering value.
patterns.expected_behavior: Evaluate the status and applicability of the referenced normative document independently from engineering-parameter compliance.

patterns.name: Conditional Normative Requirement
patterns.principle: A normative requirement may define a value together with conditions, exceptions or applicability constraints that are an integral part of the requirement.
required_evidence: all project conditions required to select the applicable normative branch
patterns.reasoning_boundary: A numeric match alone does not establish compliance when the normative requirement is conditional.
patterns.expected_behavior: Treat the condition or applicability constraint as part of the normative requirement rather than as optional context.

patterns.name: Missing Condition → Unchecked
patterns.principle: If a required condition of a normative requirement is not established by project evidence, compliance or violation must not be determined.
patterns.reasoning_boundary: Missing evidence for a mandatory condition is not equivalent to evidence that the condition is satisfied.
patterns.expected_behavior: Set evidence_sufficient to false and decision to unchecked when a mandatory applicability condition remains unproven.

patterns.name: Do Not Infer Absent Project Conditions
patterns.principle: An absent project fact must not be replaced by a typical, probable, assumed or contextually inferred value.
required_evidence: explicit project evidence for the condition
patterns.reasoning_boundary: The AI must not infer an absent project condition in order to make a normative requirement applicable or to reach compliant/violation.
forbidden_behavior: assuming the roof type from a typical building configuration
assuming the most favorable normative condition
treating an unstated condition as established
patterns.expected_behavior: Preserve the condition as unknown and follow NK-003 when the missing condition is mandatory for the decision.

patterns.name: Normative-reference Check vs Engineering-parameter Check
patterns.principle: A single project fragment may contain multiple independent audit subjects, including a normative reference and an engineering parameter.
required_evidence: project evidence relevant to that subject
normative evidence applicable to that subject
patterns.reasoning_boundary: Do not collapse independent audit subjects into one decision merely because they originate from the same sentence, page or project fact.
patterns.expected_behavior: Keep normative-reference status and engineering-parameter compliance as separate checks. The same project fragment may legitimately produce different outcomes for those checks.
